identity.philosophy: Swiss Precision meets Luxury Fintech. We build 'The Alpine Vault' - secure, pristine, elevated.
principles: Fusion: Swiss Graphic Design (Grids, Typography) + Luxury Hospitality (Warmth, Service).
Content: Data is the hero. Use whitespace to frame it.
Detail: 1px borders, subtle golden shadows, perfect alignment.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Deal names. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: UI elements, data tables, form labels. Use tracking-normal.

primary.description: Golden Bronze - The brand signature. Use for Primary Actions (Save, Create), Active States, and Key Accents.

secondary.description: Deep Slate - Used for high-contrast headers and secondary buttons.

background.description: Off-white 'Snow' background for the app. Pure white for cards.

muted.description: Light grey for secondary backgrounds and muted text.

buttons.primary: bg-[#AC7E49] hover:bg-[#9C703F] text-white rounded-sm font-medium px-6 py-2.5 transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm font-medium px-6 py-2.5 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-[#AC7E49] hover:bg-[#AC7E49]/10 rounded-sm px-4 py-2

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-md shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(172,126,73,0.15)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-[#AC7E49] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#AC7E49] rounded-sm h-10

badges.style: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase

deal_wizard.right_panel: hidden md:block md:w-1/3 bg-slate-50 border-l border-slate-200 p-8 (Live Summary/Preview)

login_background.usage: Full screen background for Login/Signup with parallax effect.

texture_overlay.usage: Subtle overlay opacity-5 on the sidebar or active card borders.

office_placeholder.usage: Empty state for 'Company Profile' or 'About' section.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use thin stroke-width (1.5px) for elegance.

motion.parallax: Use CSS 'background-attachment: fixed' for the login page background to create a simple, performant parallax effect.
motion.transitions: All interactive elements must have 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'clsx' 'tailwind-merge' if not present.
2. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the colors defined in 'design_system.colors'.
3. FONTS: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. LAYOUT: Build the 'Dashboard' using the Bento Grid strategy defined above.
5. LANGUAGE: All UI text must be in GERMAN (DE).
6. CHATBOT: Implement as a floating button (bottom-right) with the Primary Bronze color.
7. PARALLAX: Implement the Login page with the Swiss Alps image as a fixed background.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and cards.
universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients for backgrounds; use solid colors or subtle textures.
Do not center-align text in cards; left-align for readability.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
Never use pure black (#000000); use Slate-900 (#1A202C).
